feeds.title: 药物 · 临床试验
feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.title: 机制 · 基础研究
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非典型阿尔茨海默病表型患者多数不符合抗淀粉样蛋白疗法的临床试验入组标准。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可准确预测淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期认知增强药试验多数疗效有限，突显直接修复突触功能仍是AD治疗瓶颈。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经卤代或三氟甲基修饰可增强AD多靶点抑制活性，为MTDLs设计提供SAR依据。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗疗效与安全性高度异质，需按药物个体化权衡获益风险。

drug.title: Streamlining eligibility assessment for Alzheimer's disease-modifying therapies: Prediction of MMSE scores using the digital clock and recall.
drug.zh: 数字时钟与回忆测试结合机器学习可高效预测MMSE评分，简化阿尔茨海默病治疗资格评估。

drug.title: Six-month real-world amyloid PET outcomes after lecanemab: Greater amyloid reduction at the MCI stage than in dementia.
drug.zh: 真实世界数据表明，仑卡奈单抗在MCI期降淀粉样蛋白效果优于痴呆期。

drug.title: The Clearance-Centered Bottleneck in Alzheimer's Disease: From Coupled Glymphatic-Lymphatic Circuits to Therapeutic Opportunities.
drug.zh: 提出以清除为中心的新框架，指出类淋巴-淋巴耦合回路三节点失效是AD核心瓶颈。

mech.title: The Associations of cerebral blood flow and white matter hyperintensities with tau and amyloid-beta across the Alzheimer's disease spectrum.
mech.zh: 脑血流与白质高信号纵向关联tau及淀粉样病理，提示血管因素参与AD进展。

mech.title: DNA Sensing Pathways in Innate Immunity: Implications for Alzheimer's Disease Progression and Therapy.
mech.zh: DNA感知通路经I型干扰素及炎症小体加剧神经炎症，驱动AD病理与认知衰退。

mech.title: miRNA-mRNA Interaction Network Analysis in Alzheimer's Disease for Biomarker Discovery.
mech.zh: 基于ADNI与GEO数据构建miRNA-mRNA调控网络，锁定AD候选生物标志物。

mech.title: Epigenetic aging in Alzheimer's disease: Relation to proteome.
mech.zh: 表观遗传年龄加速与脑脊液蛋白网络模块显著关联，揭示AD中免疫与蛋白稳态通路改变。

mech.title: The role of polygenic risk in Alzheimer's disease prediction for African Americans.
mech.zh: 非裔美国人多基因风险评分预测ADRD效能低于欧裔，但独立于APOE4且风险比更高。

mech.title: Plasma p-tau217 detects Alzheimer's disease co-pathology in cerebral amyloid angiopathy: Comparison to CSF biomarkers in the ANGMAR cohort.
mech.zh: 血浆p-tau217可精准识别CAA合并AD共病，且不受CAA影像负担影响。

mech.title: Predicting Relevant Microglia-Associated Cell-Cell Communication Pathways in Alzheimer's Disease: A Role for SPP1.
mech.zh: SPP1介导的小胶质细胞间信号通路在阿尔茨海默病中特异性增强，或为关键治疗靶点。

mech.title: Energetic crisis, mitochondrial vulnerability and disruption of lactate shuttle in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病早期即出现脑能量危机与乳酸穿梭障碍，先于神经退行性改变。

dx.title: Astrocyte reactivity modifies the effects of locus coeruleus norepinephrine-related dysfunction on tau and its impact on cognition.
dx.zh: 蓝斑功能异常经星形胶质细胞反应加剧tau病理并促进认知衰退。

dx.title: Temporal order of clinical, imaging, and biomarker changes in frontotemporal lobar degeneration-associated syndromes.
dx.zh: FTLD谱系疾病中血浆GFAP最早偏离正常，先于临床及影像改变。

dx.title: Plasma p-tau217 detects Alzheimer's disease co-pathology in cerebral amyloid angiopathy: Comparison to CSF biomarkers in the ANGMAR cohort.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217可准确识别CAA患者合并AD病理，且不受CAA影像负担影响。

dx.title: High prevalence of tau pathologies in late-onset psychosis: A PET study.
dx.zh: 迟发性精神病患者tau蛋白病理高发，提示其或为神经退行性病变早期表现。

dx.title: Serum Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein Dynamics, Disease Progression, and Therapy Response in Multiple Sclerosis.
dx.zh: 血清GFAP动态变化可预测多发性硬化进展及治疗应答。

dx.title: Brain aging clocks: From methodological advances to cellular mechanisms.
dx.zh: 脑衰老时钟已从全局指标演进为多模态、细胞级工具，可量化区域异质性与衰老速率。

dx.title: Biomarker-Based Diagnosis and Care Pathways for Alzheimer's Disease in the Era of Disease-Modifying Treatments: A Consensus Statement by Belgian Experts.
dx.zh: 比利时专家共识：DMT时代AD诊断须以生物标志物确证淀粉样病理，并需系统改造以保公平可及。

dx.title: Motor performance and its association with Alzheimer's-related biomarkers: a systematic review.
dx.zh: 阿尔茨海默病相关生物标志物与运动功能显著关联，或可作早期筛查指标。

prev.title: Edentulism, blood-based neurodegenerative biomarkers, and 10-year dementia risk: A mediation analysis in a nationally representative United States cohort.
prev.zh: 无牙症通过升高GFAP和NfL部分介导痴呆风险，而非tau或淀粉样通路。

prev.title: Nut consumption, cognitive function and brain health markers in individuals with and without stroke: cross-sectional and longitudinal findings from the Framingham heart study.
prev.zh: 坚果摄入与无卒中者认知功能及脑容量呈正相关，但与卒中后认知衰退及痴呆风险无显著关联。

prev.title: Impact of SARS-CoV-2 infection on the progression of Alzheimer's disease: A prospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 新冠感染显著加速阿尔茨海默病患者三个月内认知功能恶化。

prev.title: Timing and Duration of Prediabetic Metabolic Dysfunction Differentially Impact Cerebral Perfusion, Vascular Structure, and Behavior.
prev.zh: 肥胖起始年龄与持续时间差异性地影响脑灌注、血管结构及认知功能。

prev.title: Plasma Concentrations of Amyloid-β Peptides, BACE-1, and Tau Proteins in Alzheimer's Disease.
prev.zh: 血浆Aβ42/Aβ40比值及BACE-1水平可辅助区分阿尔茨海默病与健康对照，诊断价值受人口学及生活方式因素影响。

prev.title: Educational attainment and sex modulate clinical outcomes in genetic frontotemporal dementia.
prev.zh: 教育程度与性别通过认知储备调节遗传性额颞叶痴呆的临床病程及进展。

prev.title: A brief checklist of modifiable dementia risk factors (RF12): associations with cognitive and affective measures in an Italian cohort.
prev.zh: RF12简表可有效关联意大利社区人群的认知与情感指标，支持其作为痴呆风险筛查工具。

prev.title: Experience-driven neural efficiency and reserve in aging: Evidence from bilingual attentional adaptation.
prev.zh: 双语经验重塑大脑控制网络，以效率提升和结构储备延缓认知老化。

intro.title: Further data to address the Alzheimer's coverage with evidence development questions.
intro.zh: 简单说，这篇综述讲的是两种治老年痴呆的新药，长期用是否安全有效，帮您判断这类药到底值不值得用。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、脑子变慢，帮普通人看懂老年痴呆和帕金森病背后的共同原因。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家在找能管住大脑里两种“捣乱酶”的药，用来缓解老年痴呆症状，帮患者和家人更清楚该关注哪些治疗方向。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述说，老年痴呆可能和大脑“缺能量”有关，早发现早调整生活习惯，或许能帮大脑保持活力。

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑发炎会加重老年痴呆和帕金森病，看懂它，能帮你明白为啥现在没特效药，以及未来新药该往哪儿使劲。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述把老年痴呆等脑病看成一张互相牵连的“坏网”，告诉你治病不能只盯一个点，得从整体下手。

intro.title: Worry and Anxiety in the Era of Early Diagnosis and Disease Modifying Treatment for Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是：查出早期老年痴呆后，心里害怕担心很正常，但学会应对这种焦虑，能让治疗和照顾更有效。

intro.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
intro.zh: 简单说，就是科学家把几种治早期老年痴呆的新药放一起比了比，看哪个更管用、更安全，帮您和家人选药时心里有底。
